title: Cyber Towers–HITEX stretch shut 9 am to noon today

slides.head: Cyber Towers–HITEX stretch shut 9 am to noon today
What happened
slides.body: Vehicles are restricted from Cyber Towers to HITEX Kaman (Metal Charminar) and up to HICC/Novotel from 9 am to 12 noon; heavy vehicles are barred on these routes.

slides.head: Why it matters
slides.body: The rally comes as Rahul Gandhi is set to launch the Telangana Platform-Based Gig Workers law at the Bharat Summit at HITEX.

slides.head: Did you know
slides.body: The Gig Workers Bill was introduced in the Assembly on March 29, 2026.

slides.head: What to watch
slides.body: Restrictions end at noon; the drone ban stays until 6 pm on November 15. Ask: What does the new gig workers' law require from delivery and ride apps?

slides.head: Spill the tea, daily
slides.body: Hyderabad news in 30 seconds, with the numbers and the questions. Follow for tomorrow's drop: spillthetea.news

captions.instagram:
Cyber Towers–HITEX stretch shut 9 am to noon today

Cyberabad Traffic Police have restricted traffic in Madhapur on November 14 for a gig workers' bike rally with Rahul Gandhi from Shilpakala Vedika to Jayabheri Grounds.

Why it matters: The rally comes as Rahul Gandhi is set to launch the Telangana Platform-Based Gig Workers law at the Bharat Summit at HITEX.

Source: The Hindu. Image: Telangana Today
